method_provenance.label: Owner earnings and reinvestment-return DCF
method_provenance.equation: cash_t = cash_(t-1)*(1+reinvestment*incremental_ROIC); value = PV(distributable cash + terminal owner earnings)

sources.locator: Owner cash, reinvestment and reverse expectations

low.label: Reinvestment rate
low.rationale: Issuer-specific review as of 2026-09-01: Managed-care cash generation is durable only when medical-cost trend, quality bonuses, and statutory capital remain controlled; the case grid therefore uses lower reinvestment returns and a higher required return than the generic quality template. Primary evidence: CNC/investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260217_rpt20251231_acc0001071739_26_000049.htm; CNC/investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-Q_20260728_rpt20260630_acc0001071739_26_000153.htm.
